connector.name: Library by postapp.win
connector.registryDescription: Publish one HTML file, get a live installable app URL. No account, no review, no queue.
connector.summary: Hosted at postapp.win over streamable HTTP. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace win.postapp, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer ak_… — a publishing key. Take one with no identity at POST https://postapp.win/api/keys (solve a proof-of-work challenge). Omit it to browse and search the library read-only.
